label: def:delta-q-decoration
title: $q$-dimension decoration $\delta_q : H_n(q) \to R^{|\mathrm{Par}(n)|}$ of the NF basis
html:
Definition (q-dimension decoration of the NF basis). The \delta_q-decoration maps an algebra element b \in H_n(q) to the tuple of its q-characters across each irreducible representation V_\lambda:

  \delta_q(b)
  \;:=\;
  \bigl(\chi_\lambda(b)\bigr)_{\lambda \vdash n}
  \;\in\;
  R^{|\,\mathrm{Par}(n)\,|}.

The decoration lands in the q-dimension layer R^{|\mathrm{Par}(n)|} (def:q-dimension-layer), the per-irrep coordinate structure that the Markov trace normally collapses.
